header.Info: Performance Monitoring Events for 12th and 13th Generation Intel(R) Core(TM) Processor - V1.41

events.BriefDescription: Counts demand read for ownership (RFO) requests and software prefetches for exclusive ownership (PREFETCHW) that resulted in a snoop hit in another cores caches, data forwarding is required as the data is modified.
events.PublicDescription: Counts demand read for ownership (RFO) requests and software prefetches for exclusive ownership (PREFETCHW) that resulted in a snoop hit in another cores caches, data forwarding is required as the data is modified.

events.BriefDescription: Retired load instructions with locked access.
events.PublicDescription: Counts retired load instructions with locked access.

events.BriefDescription: Retired load instructions missed L3 cache as data sources
events.PublicDescription: Counts retired load instructions with at least one uop that missed in the L3 cache.

events.BriefDescription: Retired load instructions whose data sources were HitM responses from shared L3
events.PublicDescription: Counts retired load instructions whose data sources were HitM responses from shared L3.
